decisions.title: 绕渠道直充正在改写手游收入判断：商店下滑不等于总收入下滑
entities: 绕渠道直充正在改写手游收入判断：商店下滑不等于总收入下滑
decisions.event: 绕渠道直充正在改写手游收入判断：商店下滑不等于总收入下滑
decisions.reason: 精确周报selection人工选择，保持C057/C008/C001顺序与指定卡片。
decisions.facts:
观察：Sensor Tower在State of Gaming Summit 2026分享的估算显示，2026年上半年手游商店内购收入约400亿美元、同比下降2%，但这一口径不包含绕渠道直充。若以此衡量手游总收入，可能低估市场规模。Monopoly GO的绕渠道直充收入据称目前约占其总收入的三分之一，单看App Store与Google Play曲线，可能把销售渠道迁移误读为产品整体衰退。

分析：收入观察的前提正在变化。只看应用商店，隐含了商店能够代表产品主要收入来源的假设；当直充网页承接更多销售，这一假设就会松动。Monopoly GO的商店估算收入看似下滑，绕渠道直充收入却显著增长至约三分之一，说明商店曲线不足以独立判断总收入方向，但也不能反过来证明总收入一定增长。Sensor Tower没有公布绕渠道直充市场总额；报道提及，Appcharge此前估算绕渠道直充市场规模可达170亿美元或更高，不能当作Sensor Tower结论，也不能与上半年400亿美元直接相加。

迁移幅度还受到品类限制。2026年上半年美国头部博彩游戏样本约30%的收入来自商店外，RPG的绕渠道直充收入占比紧随其后，桌游类也较高，策略与尤其是益智类则偏低。益智类在美国拥有的直充网页应用数量却仅次于博彩，形成开店数量与收入贡献的反差：具备渠道不等于玩家已经把支付习惯迁过去，头部博彩或单款产品的比例不能统一套给其他游戏。

绕渠道直充网页流量的组织方式同样不同。全球层面，直接访问和从社交媒体中访问是两类主要流量来源；直接访问指输入网址、书签或保存链接等入口，不等于已经证明获客免费。Supercell的绕渠道网页直充中，56%的流量来自直接访问，37%来自社交媒体访问，报道同时提及其创作者社群支持；Raid: Shadow Legends的绕渠道网页直充中，47%的流量来自直接访问，49%来自社交媒体访问，后者超过直接访问占比，Plarium通过Facebook和TikTok活动导流。两组数字说明社交媒体访问在绕渠道直充网页的流量中可能占据较大份额，但它们是流量占比，不是收入占比，也没有给出转化率或投放回报，不能据此断言某一种渠道更赚钱。

decisions.title: Steam成功新品扩容，Roguelite上升不能只用低价解释
entities: Steam成功新品扩容，Roguelite上升不能只用低价解释
decisions.event: Steam成功新品扩容，Roguelite上升不能只用低价解释
decisions.reason: 精确周报selection人工选择，保持C057/C008/C001顺序与指定卡片。
decisions.facts:
观察： GameDiscoverCo对2021与2025年Steam成功新品的标签比较显示，Roguelite在销量口径和收入口径都升至第一；与此同时，达到5万份销量的样本从261款增至469款，中位价格从19.99美元降至16.99美元。命中池变大了，但更低价格和更强复玩结构也在重写什么样的产品更容易进入这个池。

分析： 这套变化首先不是单纯的题材轮换，而是成功门槛与消费结构共同移动。以销量超过5万份为门槛时，2025年的低价产品更容易入样本；切换到年收入超过100万美元后，样本仍从196款增至311款，Roguelite依然排名第一，说明随机流程与重复游玩并非只靠低价放大，而是已经进入较高收入产品的核心结构。

传统大类没有整体消失，而是在混合化。动作RPG在销量口径仍升至第4，FPS在收入口径只降至第3；JRPG、即时战略和回合制策略在销量口径明显下滑，却在收入口径下降较少。更可能发生的是成熟品类被Roguelite、Hack and Slash等循环结构重新包装，而不是玩家突然停止购买传统类型。

对供给侧而言，成功样本扩容意味着机会增加，但469款达到销量门槛的产品也会争夺更分散的注意力。价格下移和复玩机制同时上升，把竞争从一次性内容规模推向循环密度、可重复性和更清晰的类型承诺；Steam标签不能替代产品判断，却能显示玩家如何用更少的单次支出筛选更多可长期游玩的新品。

decisions.title: 170%综合分成背后，微信把激励锁进同一产品的投放循环
entities: 170%综合分成背后，微信把激励锁进同一产品的投放循环
decisions.event: 170%综合分成背后，微信把激励锁进同一产品的投放循环
decisions.reason: 精确周报selection人工选择，保持C057/C008/C001顺序与指定卡片。
decisions.facts:
观察： 微信小游戏把首发IAP新游的最高综合分成抬至170%，但这并非单纯降低平台抽成，而是现金分成、广告金与暑期增量激励的组合。9月22日起，首发激励金又被限定用于同一appid的广告主账户，平台正在把首发、流水增长和再投放串成一个闭环。

分析： 这套机制先用首1000万流水不分成和最高400万元首发激励降低冷启动成本；新游期月流水首次突破1000万元后，后续4000万元流水可在6个月内按月结算激励。开发者因此获得更早的投放资源，而平台把激励释放速度与产品实际流水进度绑定。

170%的口径也需要拆开理解：其中只有60%是现金，其他部分来自基础激励金、成长激励金、PC广告金、首发激励与暑期专项激励。名义分成高于100%，本质上是平台用广告资源换取开发者继续在同一产品上扩量，并把获量支出留在微信广告体系内。

边界同样明确。最高比例要求满足微信首发、新游期流水门槛与暑期增量消耗等条件，且9月22日后广告金不能跨产品调配。因而它更像针对有能力快速放量的新IAP产品的加速器，而不是所有小游戏都能获得的普遍现金补贴。

decisions.facts: I find myself pretty gloomy about the shutdown of 2XKO—but not because I'll miss it on a personal level. I don't have the mental bandwidth to training-montage myself into a serious fighting game player other than a few stints with Guilty Gear: Strive, but I did have a reasonable time messing around with 2XKO during its beta. And while I'm aware my lack of continued playing makes me part of the problem, I genuinely felt a little sad to see it sink into the waves as Riot announced it was winding down development .

There are some really solid budget picks (with Creative's Pebble Pro being our budget speaker of choice ), but the $100-200 range is where you get the most features and the best price-to-value ratio. Go beyond that and you're spending a lot of money for only incrementally better sound and some non-essential luxuries.

decisions.facts: One of the biggest global gaming events of the year is nearly upon us: Gamescom week is here.There are few shows like it in the industry calendar. Last year’s event attracted 357,000 visitors, up 7% year-over-year. For the first time ever, the expo floor has been completely sold out, according to organisers.It’s a truly global event. As I noted in my event takeaways last year, walking across the show floor it was clear how companies from Asia are looking to make a splash worldwide. There were big games present including HoYoverse with Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rail and Zenless Zone Zero, Amazing Seasun Games with Mecha Break, Hypergryph’s Arknights: Endfield and Infold Games’ Infinity Nikki, to name just a few.I expect the same this year. In fact, side events include Tencent’s ‘Worlds of Play’ global art exhibition featuring its in-house and partner studios, bringing some of China’s top titles to Cologne. At the recent ChinaJoy event in Shanghai - the country’s own Gamescom that attracted some 438,900 visitors - one of the themes was China’s ambition to go global. Companies like Discord were in town, despite not being available in China. Much of the B2B show floor was filled to the brim with ads and payments firms, many sharing the same goal: to get a piece of the pie as China’s top companies expand worldwide.We’ll be on the ground at Gamescom identifying the biggest trends to report back. As well as Asia’s growing influence, I’ll be looking at whether entertainment companies like Netflix and Paramount are expanding their presence to promote both their shows and games.

decisions.facts: Back in February Epic Games told us about its plan to overhaul the Epic launcher , with an update in June mentioning it would start up five times faster on average . That technical overhaul will apparently be accompanied by changes to the storefront including personalized game recommendations, quick-access categories, and patch notes right there on the shop. All stuff that would have been nice to have at the end of 2018 when the Epic launcher arrived, but is it too late for a recovery? I asked Emmanuel Rosier, director of market intelligence at industry analysts Newzoo .

decisions.facts: We don't really need more Baldur's Gate 3 , given how vast and replayable Larian Studios' RPG already is. That said, I'd never say no to more adventures within Larian's highly flexible adaptation of the Forgotten Realms. And while Larian itself has sworn off expanding BG3 any further, the modding community is still plugging away with new stuff, including the recent release of a 6-hour campaign revolving around everyone's favourite nefarious vampire elf Astarion.

Nope, it's Gamescom Opening Night Live day, the second Geoff Keighley-hosted world premieres showcase of each year that kicks off the gaming trade event in Cologne, Germany which signals the end of the Gregorian Calendar's videogame 'announcements season' and the beginning of traditional 'release season,' to those who observe the old ways. decisions.facts: Nvidia's new DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction feature is laser-focused on trying to fix the second most annoying thing about ray traced or path traced games: visual artifacting. Yes, the lighting effect does deliver the most accurate-looking lighting and shadows in games, but in motion there is a definite visual weirdness added into scenes. And that weirdness generally comes from the denoising pass designed to turn the low-fidelity path traced image, with its limited number of rays, into a fully realised frame.

decisions.facts: 豆包工作（豆包 Work）是当前企业接入Agent门槛最低的路径，但需用飞书账号登录才能解锁满血功能。实测可用手机远程控制最多7台设备、定时任务、自动读取本地skill、侧边栏直接编辑并同步飞书，且管理员看不到聊天记录。作者认为Work Agent是token消耗倍增器，飞书原生生态是豆包工作相比Claude Cowork、Codex Work的核心优势。
